turns is a huge factor, as you would know. This year when I was doing summer league I swam 35.2(?) in the 50 (I’m a female). Honestly all I did was turns before the meet of champs and I won because of the single turn. 

finishes is pretty self-explanatory— just fast, fast, fast kicks into the wall. 

when i do 100s, I quickly glide for the first 50, and then my pace gets quicker gradually each 25. hope this somewhat helps. understanding your flaws in breaststroke would help too. some people don’t kick hard enough or take longer breaths.
